sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection list I2, which must be 
 performed every three months as indicated by M3 in the above titled block.

This compressor serves is compressing air for self-cleaning system which is 
 using to clean the Gas Turbine air filters and to control opening and closing 
 of inlet damper.

The first draft initiated by eng. Dalia Harhash Abd-Elfatah, tested by eng. 
 Ahmad El-Saeedy, accepted by eng. general manager eng. Khamis Elsherif
 revised by MDEPC quality control 
 eng. Abouda El Bana and approved by eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby 
 head sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This document certified by eng. 
 Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control general director, MPIS 
 coordinator and approved by eng. 
 Mohamed Nagib Inspection and quality control head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area

Wear your safety, helmet, shoes and 
 gloves pairs
Compressor unit shutdown

Disconnect the power supply of the 
 compressor
Isolate the compressor mechanically
Complete maintenance tool set.
Compressed air hose

Cleaning articles (fluid, rags, soft brushes. 
 etc)
Soft brushes
Spray gun

sections.text: Inspect any leakage from compressor unit
Check and inspect inlet and outlet valves and change any damage parts

items: Check safety valve
Inspect any leakage from compressor unit
Check and inspect inlet and outlet valves and change any damage parts
Inspect cooler for leaks

Remove small air filter element it 
 by air jet

Remove dismantle and clean float 
 valve of moisture trap
Change the oil of the compressor

Inspect tension belt and check 
 pulleys and change it if necessary

Adjust pressure of open and close 
 safety valve
